slides.title: Three Subatomic Particles
bullets: Proton: charge +1, mass 1, in the nucleus
Neutron: charge 0, mass 1, in the nucleus
Electron: charge -1, mass ~0, in shells around the nucleus
slides.note: A neutral atom has equal numbers of protons and electrons.

slides.title: Atomic Number and Mass Number
bullets: Z (atomic number) = number of protons — defines the element

slides.title: Isotopes
bullets: Same element, same protons, different neutrons
Identical chemistry, different mass and nuclear stability
Relative atomic mass = weighted average of isotope masses

slides.title: Forming Ions
bullets: Atoms gain/lose electrons to reach a full outer shell
slides.note: Protons never change when an ion forms — only electrons move.
